description: This file defines the ActionManager class for managing actions within the Excalidraw application, including registering actions, handling keyboard events, executing actions, rendering action panels, and tracking events.

classes.name: ActionManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing actions, handling keyboard events, executing actions, rendering action panels, and tracking events within the application.

methods.name: trackAction
methods.description: Function to log or track an action event with category, action, and source details.

methods.name: registerAction
methods.description: Registers a single action into the ActionManager.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events to trigger registered actions based on key tests and context.

methods.name: executeAction
methods.description: Executes a specified action programmatically, with optional source and value.

methods.name: renderAction
methods.description: Renders the UI panel for a specific action if applicable.

methods.name: isActionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given action is enabled based on current application state and predicate.
